instruction:
Open Obsidian and create a note named "Projects/Customer Interview Summary.md". Set its content to exactly:

# Customer Interview Summary

The team from Portland wants a simpler onboarding checklist.
reference_command:
content=$(printf '%b' '# Customer Interview Summary

The team from Portland wants a simpler onboarding checklist.
'); obsidian-cli create "Projects/Customer Interview Summary.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

parameters.expected_content:
# Customer Interview Summary

The team from Portland wants a simpler onboarding checklist.
